settings.heading: A Real Brand, Built By a Real Person
settings.body:
Hi, I’m the founder of Iron Phoenix.

I went to Eisenberg School of Business, left to raise my sons after losing my mother, and later worked in home healthcare. After a tough relapse in 2016, I needed a new path. I discovered design, learned the hard way that big platforms favor big budgets, and decided to build something real—this brand. Every order supports a real person, not a corporation. Thank you for being here and proving small brands still matter.
